scope: Exact contraction scheduling of the existing same-k frozen H0 + Vstage + g(u); not new DFT physics or an evolution result

legacy_timing.scope: one complete 346-column action, CPU6; original output not retained; norm is not an elementwise equivalence check

implementation.api: FrozenMaterialAction(h0, coupling=None, *, potential=None, direction=None, fft_block_size=8, projector_block_size=64).apply(vectors); .adjoint_apply(vectors)
implementation.reuse: Original MaterialHamiltonian, PWFactors, SpeciesProjectors.apply, PhysicalRhoFFT and coupling.ionic.prepare. Identity requires shared checked factors, not merely matching dimensions. No new radial/projector/DFT reconstruction.
implementation.local: Copy and sum saved vrs[:,ispin-1], optional complex stage potential and prepared complex ionic field once; one inverse/forward physical-grid transform per FFT column block.
implementation.nonlocal: SpeciesProjectors.apply on wide column panels independent of FFT paneling. Ionic prepared terms retain +i BD Bdagger diag(p.u) and -i diag(p.u) BD Bdagger separately; exact conjugate-transposed factors for adjoint, without a Hermiticity assumption.
implementation.zero_policy: Only exact zero direction or exactly zero combined local field may skip work; no norm thresholds.
implementation.memory: Output one full frame; transient PW/grid work bounded by explicit 64-column projector and 8-column FFT panels; no PW-square matrix. Cached factors/prepared terms remain sector-local. Threadpool limit 1 on each apply.
implementation.ownership: Caller must not mutate checked H0/coupling factors. Potential/direction snapshots are copied during construction. Rebuild only when frozen stage changes. H0-only object omits potential and direction. No D contractions or hidden H0 counters in production API.

oracle.independent_reference: Explicit finite Fourier matrix, independent analytic displaced-projector derivative and dense H assembled from random complex beta and non-Hermitian complex species D. Complex frames and arbitrary complex raw coefficient D are contracted without repair.
oracle.cases: H0, real and complex ionic direction, nonzero saved/stage/ionic fields, adjoint, complex linearity, single column, panel boundaries, exact-zero and tiny nonzero directions.
oracle.sensitivity: Reject omission of kinetic, saved local, stage local, ionic local, species nonlocal, either ionic derivative leg, either derivative sign, conjugation of direction, Hermitization of active D or raw D.
oracle.acceptance: relative dense action/adjoint/contraction residual <= 2e-11; all named mutation residuals > 1e-8; persist finite reference/actions/differences.

material.inputs: Authenticate original pilot result, its input bindings, source-bound passing fused oracle, exact boundary, selected raw frame and original fixed complex D. Reuse unchanged build_evolution_model and factory.
material.probes: Saved first/last raw columns plus deterministic complex full-PW vectors orthogonally projected out of ALL saved columns via Gram solve; verify complement residual and retain probes. Compare legacy and fused H0, initial stage, nonzero named real/complex atom directions and nonzero complex field. Save actions/differences and quantitative errors.
material.timing: Execute only NEW full346-column initial frozen action; retain full array and exact binding, elapsed time, RSS/PSS, CPU affinity and native threadpool receipts. Do not rerun lost legacy full frame. Compare legacy scalar norm only as historical evidence, not proof.
material.direction_semantics: Probe displacements/fields are algebraic equivalence challenges with explicit saved arrays, not invented physical initial conditions. Full action uses only actual original stage u and K(delta n).
material.acceptance: Every actual probe relative residual <= 2e-11; selected full frame has346 columns. No speedup claim before actual execution.

integration.unchanged_active_jobs: Do not edit physical-field moments code, source dependencies, factories or active source manifests while those runs are bound. New module and consumers are opt-in only.
integration.later_cutover: After Root authorizes source cutover, have factory yield checked raw MaterialHamiltonian as well as coupling. Construct H0-only FrozenMaterialAction once per sector and a frozen full action once per stage/sector. Wrap each apply with the SAME global H0 reservation, once per call and exact number of requested columns, including exponential adjoint requests and energy-only H0 calls. Never reserve both wrapper and legacy counted_h0. Keep existing reductions/weights/raw D/physical stage construction unchanged.
integration.adjoint: Use adjoint_apply for complex stage directions/fields. Existing exponential_action assumes self-adjoint physical real stages; do not feed arbitrary complex challenges through that shortcut.

limitations: Same-k q=0 only; not rectangular finite-q
One-sector equivalence/timing does not establish full rollout runtime, energy convergence or a material trajectory
Global H0 reservation remains Root-owned integration work
